name: windstack-sdk

scripts.format: biome format --write packages/*/src scripts package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json packages/*/package.json packages/*/tsconfig.json specs/wisp-provider-contract.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format packages/*/src scripts package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json packages/*/package.json packages/*/tsconfig.json specs/wisp-provider-contract.json biome.json
scripts.build:native: tsc -b packages/crypto packages/abi packages/rpc packages/contract packages/account packages/antelope packages/session
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/evm packages/solana packages/crypto packages/abi packages/rpc packages/contract packages/account packages/antelope packages/vexanium packages/wallet-plugin-wisp packages/session
scripts.test: node scripts/test-signing.mjs && node scripts/test-provider-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-provider-spec.mjs && node scripts/test-sdk-behavior.mjs && node scripts/test-native-antelope.mjs
scripts.validate:native: npm run clean && npm run format:check && npm run check:release && npm run build:native && npm run test:native && npm run pack:native
scripts.validate: npm run clean && npm run format:check && npm run check:release && npm run build && npm test && npm run pack:dry-run
scripts.release:dry-run: npm run validate:native && npm run verify:vexanium

author: Gilang Ramadan
description: TypeScript SDK packages for WindStack applications across Antelope, Vexanium, EVM, Solana, and Wisp Wallet.
